overview: As the first Filipino Street Fighter, Yasmine zips onto the scene with blindingly high speed and relentless close quarters mixups. Boasting a lightning fast drive rush, good walk speed, a plethora of forward advancing normals and body projectile specials, a boomerang projectile that creates setups, and a wide variety of way to generate safe combo enders, Yasmine is a dizzyingly aggressive close quarters fighter.

And mixups you will have to enact, because her damage is some of the worst in the game. Many of Yasmine's normals and target combos have scaling, and her bread-and-butter routing go into specials that add even more. Her Demon Raid leap and boomerang are useful tools, but in addition to being slow and vulnerable (especially compared to the wide cast of shotos) they aggressively scale when starting combos too. She suffers from weak medium ranges and awkward conversions, forcing her back into her forward-advancing moves, which in a kit as straightforward as hers can feel limiting and constrained.

Don't let that scare you though -- Yasmine is an easy to pick up character who can stick her opponent in a blender of terrifying aggression. If you want to rep the Philippines with pride, take her for a spin and see how holding a karambit feels.

moves.name: Drive Parry
moves.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: Drive Rush Cancel
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: Parry Drive Rush
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.708 (min/throw), 2.478 (min/block), 3.918 (max/final DR frame)
